'''Pelipper''' (Japanese: '''ペリッパー''' ''Pelipper'') is a {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} owned by [[Team Rocket]] that delivers the [[Rocket Prize Master]] to [[Jessie]], [[James]], and {{MTR}} during ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]''.

==In animation==
===History===
==={{aniseries|JN}}===
[[File:Rocket Prize Master delivery.png|thumb|left|250px|The Rocket Prize Master having been delivered to Jessie, James, and Meowth]]
In ''[[JN003|Ivysaur's Mysterious Tower!]]'', {{an|Giovanni}} informed {{TRT}} of a new secret weapon that he granted the trio access to. Pelipper delivered the [[Rocket Prize Master]] to them in [[Vermilion City]], when they were confronted by {{Ash}} and [[Goh]] whilst they were trying to steal a group of {{p|Bulbasaur}} and {{p|Ivysaur}}.

In ''[[JN017|Kicking It from Here Into Tomorrow!]]'', Pelipper was resting in Vermilion City when Goh came across it and attempted to catch it. This caused Pelipper to fly away, inadvertently leading Goh to discover Team Rocket's secret base.

Pelipper continued to deliver the Rocket Prize Machine to the trio whenever they request it.

In ''[[JN049|To Train, or Not to Train!]]'', Pelipper was used in battle by [[James]] when the Rocket Prize Master did not deliver a {{i|Poké Ball}} to the trio. Initially, Pelipper managed to withstand [[Professor Cerise's Yamper]]'s attacks, but it lost after Yamper teamed up with an {{p|Eevee}}.

As time went by, Pelipper got closer to [[Jessie]], James, and {{MTR}}, resting with the group in a calmer time. In ''[[JN058|A Rollicking Roll…]]'', Pelipper tried to use the Rocket Prize Master while everyone was resting; due to a malfunction, the equipment ended up releasing several Poké Balls containing {{p|Gulpin}}.

In ''[[JN069|Errand Endurance!]]'', Team Rocket sent Pelipper to get them some [[Casteliacone]]s to go with their {{wp|apple pie}}. With help from Team Rocket, Pelipper was able to collect the Casteliacones and returned to their base with them, only for {{TP|James|Morpeko}} to eat them before they could.

In ''[[JN081|Mad About Blue!]]'', Team Rocket called the Prize Master after their attempt to steal Pikachu, Grookey and Eevee failed. As Pelipper arrived, [[Bluto]] and [[Gorman]] became immediately drawn to its shade of blue. Their attention unnerved Pelipper, causing it to fly away in a panic with the Prize Master in tow.

In ''[[JN106|Radio Lulled the Mischievous Stars!]]'', Pelipper gained a role in Team Rocket's new radio show, starring in a segment that had the listeners guess what was inside its bill.

===Personality and characteristics===
Pelipper is dedicated to its job of delivering the [[Rocket Prize Master]] to {{TRT}} at their request, no matter where they are. Pelipper is also capable of evading capture, such as when it flew off to avoid being {{pkmn2|caught}} by [[Goh]] in ''[[JN017|Kicking It from Here Into Tomorrow!]]''. When the Prize Master malfunctions and no Pokémon are sent out, Pelipper voluntarily steps in to assist, as seen in ''[[JN049|To Train, or Not to Train!]]''.

Pelipper is strong in battle, as seen in ''To Train, or Not to Train!'', where it was even able to withstand a supereffective {{m|Spark}} from [[Professor Cerise's Yamper]].

Pelipper is shown to be absent-minded, as seen in ''[[JN069|Errand Endurance!]]'', when Team Rocket had to disguise themselves as ice cream vendors and give Pelipper the ice cream themselves when it forgot what it was supposed to be doing.
